title: Simply Great
body:
Leonardo Da Vinci said that,
"Simplisity is the ultimate sophistication"
Well, Any.DO really embodies this proverb for it is the most simple, clean and easy to understand UI that I have ever had the pleasure of using in a todo-app before. 
A great use of the voice recognition to quickly create new todos (although my command: "Get a washing slot", turned out "Get a washing slut" lol). 
Intuitive and useful. 
Props to the developers!!
